desertProblem: Exploring the desert calls for maps prepared before a trip, access to routes and points of interest without a live connection, and a way to keep a personal record of the journey.
desertSolution: A Flutter application for iOS and Android combines downloadable satellite maps, a local library of routes and places, GPS recording, and GPX/KML exchange. Pro access is managed through a one-time purchase with RevenueCat.
desertChallenges: Coordinate map display, route recording, and group sharing through a shared GPS acquisition session. Handle permission changes, interrupted connectivity, and late responses without confusing local capture with confirmed remote publication. Validate complete imports before saving any data.
desertArchitecture: Feature modules separate presentation, application controllers, domain contracts, and data services. AppScope supplies dependencies; ChangeNotifier and streams drive state. Drift/SQLite stores personal routes locally, Mapbox handles maps, and Firebase Cloud Functions with Firestore serve location groups and Wallet passes.
desertFeatures: Downloadable offline maps, included and personal points of interest, segmented route recording, GPX/KML import, and GPX export. The repository also implements temporary location groups; end-to-end store-build and extended device validation remain pending. Live sharing requires connectivity.
desertTechnology: Flutter and Dart; Mapbox Maps; Drift and SQLite; Firebase Authentication, App Check, Firestore, and Cloud Functions; TypeScript and Node.js; RevenueCat. Swift and Kotlin bridges connect Flutter to native platform capabilities.
desertLessons: Design takeaways from the implementation: separate durable local state from network confirmation; represent permissions and purchase access explicitly; make retries idempotent; and treat on-device behavior as a separate validation layer from automated tests.
desertPractices: Transactional imports and database migrations; explicit session state machines; server-side identity, membership, and expiration checks; Flutter unit/widget tests and Firestore rules tests. GitHub Actions checks formatting, analysis, and Flutter tests. Firebase integrates crash reporting, performance monitoring, and analytics.
